role: CCP §340.5 MICRA defendant — medical malpractice (specialty mismatch in disability evaluation)
theory_of_liability: Board-certified neurosurgeon used as medical source to deny SSA disability claim involving conditions outside neurosurgery. CCP §340.5 provides 1-year statute of limitations for medical malpractice (3 years from injury or 1 year from discovery, whichever first). MICRA (Civ. Code §3333.2) caps non-economic damages at $350,000 (adjusted). The specialty mismatch — Beverly Hills elective spine surgeon evaluating disability for non-neurosurgical conditions — is the core malpractice theory.

micra_considerations.statute_of_limitations: CCP §340.5 — 1 year from discovery, 3 years from injury
micra_considerations.prelitigation_requirement: CCP §364 — 90-day notice of intent to sue required before filing
